description: This file contains the implementation of a builder class used to create responses for live command queries related to feature definitions within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes a final class that extends a generic answer builder, with methods to generate success and error responses based on feature accessibility.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A mutable builder class with a fluent API for creating a LiveCommandAnswer response for a RetrieveFeatureDefinitionLiveCommand. It extends an abstract builder and contains an inner class that constructs response objects.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: An inner class implementing ResponseFactory, providing methods to generate success and error responses.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the builder for a given command.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Overrides method to generate a CommandResponse using a provided factory function.
